opportunities.point: Commercial production for the new MCT Oil project is expected to begin in the fourth quarter of FY 2026-27.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Subject to successful completion of installation, commissioning and statutory approvals, commercial production is expected to commence during the fourth quarter of the Financial Year 2026-27." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

opportunities.point: Management expects the subsidiary to contribute significantly to long-term revenue growth and profitability once commissioned.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "The management remains confident that, upon successful commissioning of the project, the subsidiary will contribute meaningfully to the Company's long-term revenue growth and profitability." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

opportunities.point: Crestchem incorporated Oleo Biosciences Private Limited as a subsidiary with 75% equity participation to set up an MCT Oil manufacturing facility.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "As part of its long-term growth strategy, the Company incorporated Oleo Biosciences Private Limited, Bengaluru, as its subsidiary with an equity participation of 75% for setting up a manufacturing facility for Medium Chain Triglyceride (MCT) Oil, a high-value..." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

opportunities.point: Procurement and installation of plant, machinery, and utilities for the project are currently in progress.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The procurement and installation of plant and machinery, utilities and other equipment for the project are presently in progress." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

opportunities.point: Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
The global and Indian MCT market is experiencing healthy growth due to rising consumer awareness of preventive healthcare and ketogenic diets.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The global and Indian MCT market continues to witness healthy growth due to increasing consumer awareness regarding preventive healthcare, ketogenic diets, sports nutrition and functional foods." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

opportunities.point: Growing demand from pharmaceutical and medical nutrition applications is expected to support long-term industry growth.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Growing demand from pharmaceutical and medical nutrition applications, coupled with increasing acceptance of clean-label ingredients, is expected to support long-term industry growth." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company is currently implementing small to medium-sized mandates, resulting in moderate profits.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "At present, the Company is implementing small to medium size mandates and accordingly, the profits too are moderate." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The company faces project execution risks including procurement timelines, installation schedules, and regulatory approvals.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "As the project is currently under implementation, the Company continues to monitor project execution risks, including procurement timelines, installation and commissioning schedules, availability of utilities, regulatory approvals, cost escalations and market..." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

threats.point: Exchange rate fluctuations affecting export competitiveness represent a threat to the business.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Exchange rate fluctuations affecting export competitiveness." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

threats.point: The company has a pending income tax demand of Rs. 2,06,000 for a prior period, which it has clarified is not required to be paid.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "During the year under review, the Company has received the notice from I one income tax demand of Rs. 2,06,000/- for prior period is yet pending though as per our company the same is not required to be paid for which we have already submitted our..." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S26/W16/O29/T11), led by 'Buying below the model's intrinsic value leaves room for a re-rating', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
